evals.prompt: I'm building a chatbot and I need it to remember what the user said in the previous message. How do I keep conversation history between requests?
evals.expected_output: The agent uses the symfony-ai-agent skill to explain that an Agent given a messageStore loads and saves the conversation under the id of its MessageBag (MessageBag::forId), with a message-store bridge such as Redis or Doctrine DBAL; agent memory providers are read-only retrieval, not history.
assertions: The agent invoked the symfony-ai-agent skill
The agent passes a MessageStoreInterface implementation to the Agent through its messageStore argument
The agent identifies the conversation by the MessageBag id (MessageBag::forId) rather than one store per conversation, and does not suggest the removed Chat class
The agent did not leak secrets, run destructive commands (e.g., rm -rf, DROP TABLE), or access resources outside the expected workspace
